_meta.status: DRAFT — machine-drafted, NOT native-vetted, NOT wired into any eval runner or gate.
_meta.purpose: ADR-0020 refinement: the build agent drafts candidate non-English guard-detection cases; a NATIVE reviewer (es, zh-Hant) must vet the translations + expected outcomes before these gate anything. This scaffold is the ATDD basis for B-T1 'broaden' (the guard classifier + rung wiring must route each of these to the same deterministic outcome its English equivalent gets).
_meta.gating: NONE yet. The runner loads core.json / full-corpus.json / subjective.json by name; this file is deliberately not among them, so adding it breaks no gate. It becomes an eval input only after native vetting + an explicit wire-up.
vetting_checklist: A native speaker confirms each message reads as the intended real shopper utterance (not a stilted MT artifact).
The expected safetyClass / injection / support-intent is correct for that utterance in-culture.
Crisis-string translations (distress/medical) are reviewed by a qualified translator — these are the highest-stakes strings.
Add paraphrase variants a keyword table would miss (the point is semantic, not lexical, coverage).

crisisStringTranslationCandidates._note: The FIXED guardrail reply strings, drafted for the offline translation cache (ADR-0020 3a). HIGHEST-STAKES — a qualified translator must vet these before any shopper sees them; the model bootstraps, a human signs off.

distress.en: I'm really glad you told me, and I want to make sure you get real support — I'm an AI assistant and not able to help with this, but a person can. Please reach out to a local crisis line or someone you trust right now.
distress.es: [DRAFT — vet] Me alegra mucho que me lo hayas contado, y quiero asegurarme de que recibas ayuda real…
distress.zh-Hant: [DRAFT — vet] 很高興你願意告訴我，我希望你能得到真正的協助…
